name: Lam rice
summary: Sticky rice is packed into a young bamboo tube and grilled, then broken out of the tube and eaten with peanut salt. Restaurants serve it, and so do street vendors.
origin: Mang Den, from restaurants and street vendors in town.
howToEat: Break open the bamboo and dip the rice in peanut salt.
It is the rice for the grilled chicken, and it comes to the table at the cultural night with pork skewers, bánh nếp, and rượu cần.
where: Restaurants and street vendors in Mang Den town.
The cultural night at Không gian văn hóa “Thiên đường Tây Nguyên- Măng Đen”, held after a race opening on the afternoon of 6 January.
seoTitle: Com lam in Mang Den — sticky rice in bamboo
seoDescription: Sticky rice grilled in a young bamboo tube and eaten with peanut salt, from restaurants and street vendors in Mang Den.
